LanguageData.RM_TitanicCorpseSite_Scavengers: {0} have caught the scent of the {1} and are coming to feed.
LanguageData.RM_TitanicCorpseSite_CampText: A party from {0} has come to camp by the {1} and cut their share of it. They will stay a while, then go.
LanguageData.RM_TitanPassage_TremorText: The ground shudders in slow, heavy beats from the {0}. Something enormous is walking this way, and it does not live here.\n\nWhatever it is will cross the map. Anything built in its path may not survive it.
LanguageData.RM_TitanPassage_Faded: The tremors fade. Whatever it was has turned away.
LanguageData.RM_TitanPassage_ArriveText: A {0} has walked onto the map. It is passing through, and it will not go around what stands in its way.
